version.changelog: The client reads no environment variable except the API key (request timeout is now a constant).

llm.summary: This skill appears to be a straightforward Naver search wrapper that uses one disclosed ScraperSocial API key and a fixed API host.

dimensions.detail: The skill necessarily sends user queries and the ScraperSocial API key to api.scrapersocial.com, which is disclosed and proportionate for an API-backed search skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup only asks the user to export SCRAPERSOCIAL_KEY; there are no package installs, dependency hooks, postinstall behavior, or generated persistence mechanisms.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to Node scripts, four documented Naver endpoints, query parameters, and JSON output; no prompt hijacking, unrelated agent instructions, or hidden workflows were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, credential-store access, background workers, privilege escalation, scheduled tasks, or persistent state changes were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to fetch public Naver blog, cafe, local, and shopping search results, and the bundled scripts only implement those API calls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that searches and your ScraperSocial API key are sent to ScraperSocial, and API usage may consume credits. The artifact does not show hidden local access or persistence beyond that disclosed API behavior.
llm.findings:
[LP1] expected: The environment-variable use is disclosed in SKILL.md and implemented as reading only SCRAPERSOCIAL_KEY for API authentication.
[LP1] expected: The network use is disclosed and constrained in code to the constant host https://api.scrapersocial.com.
[LP1] expected: The shell/Node use is expected for bundled helper scripts; artifact instructions describe running node scripts and no unrelated shell behavior was found.
